# SEP-IRA or Solo 401(k): how much more can you save in 2026?

> Free 2026 calculator comparing a SEP-IRA and a Solo 401(k) for a sole proprietor or single-member LLC: how much each lets you contribute, the dollar gap, the tax it is worth at your marginal rate, and the profit at which each plan maxes out. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
